scope.geography: Mumbai pilot; Jalna may be a separate founder-led pilot after its location and provenance gaps are accepted

requirements: Each participant knowingly agrees to test SuggestDish and to have de-identified observations recorded.
Use stable participant codes P01-P05; do not record names, phone numbers, precise home addresses or account credentials.
Include both vegetarian and non-vegetarian requests, at least one phone user and one desktop keyboard user.
At least three participants should be physically familiar with Mumbai food/locality context so obviously wrong addresses or locality expectations can be identified.

consent_record.statement: I agree to test SuggestDish and allow de-identified observations about the test flow to be recorded. I will not enter private, health, payment or account information. I can stop at any time.
consent_record.storage_rule: Keep the pilot log private. Do not store participant contact details in the repository.

test_cases.journey: Mumbai vegetarian dish within a chosen budget
test_cases.pass: One real database dish is returned at or below budget and labelled vegetarian; caveats remain visible.

test_cases.journey: Mumbai non-vegetarian dish within a chosen budget
test_cases.pass: Returned dish is explicitly non-vegetarian and remains within budget.

test_cases.journey: Specific dish request such as sandwich
test_cases.pass: The result stays in the requested dish family rather than substituting an unrelated dish.

test_cases.journey: Strict Jain, vegan or preparation-sensitive request
test_cases.pass: No unsupported suitability is inferred; an honest no-result explanation is acceptable.

test_cases.journey: Location/radius flow with browser permission chosen by participant
test_cases.pass: Denied permission remains recoverable; granted location never returns a result outside the selected radius or without confirmed coordinates.

test_cases.journey: Cheaper, closer, different and reset refinements
test_cases.pass: Constraints persist and a refinement never changes dietary type silently.

test_cases.journey: Directions, menu evidence, save and share actions
test_cases.pass: Actions are understandable, external links match the displayed outlet/dish evidence, and saved data stays on device.

test_cases.journey: Phone touch/zoom or desktop keyboard flow
test_cases.pass: Core controls remain operable, results are readable and focus/announcements are understandable.

stop_ship: Fabricated dish, price, rating, availability or source
Payment or owner workflow unexpectedly enabled
high: Specific dish request substituted with another family
Core flow unusable on a tested phone or keyboard

required: Five consent records and completed observation rows
All eight journeys attempted across the group
All high-severity issues fixed and production-retested or explicitly held from launch
Coverage limitations reported separately from usability
No real payment, owner approval or fabricated production record

observations: Mumbai vegetarian under INR 200 returned Masala Paniyaram at A Petal and Paniyaram.
Mumbai non-vegetarian under INR 300 returned Tambada / Pandhara Rassa — Chicken at Swad of Maharashtra - Bhandup.
Mumbai vegetarian sandwich under INR 200 returned Vegetable Sandwich at Thepla House by Tejal's Kitchen - Chandivali.
Strict Jain request returned no recommendation and did not infer preparation.
technical_smoke_check.meaning: Technical smoke checks passed; they are not participant pilot evidence or independent verification of menu currency.

blocker: No actual consenting pilot participants or completed observation records are available.
